verdicts.reason: A: the heart monster, bell, candy cane and gifts are jammed into one colliding knot against the M of MERRY. DISCOUNT runs straight into the small monsters, and the right side is an overstuffed run (holly on the red monster, ghost, tall monster) that hits the canvas edge. On top of that, DISCOUNT is tiny at this height. B has the same weak structure: small DISCOUNT, illustrations crowding the headline, gifts and candy cane pressed against the M, and the bell touching the heart monster. Its characters are spaced a little more evenly, with breathing room before the last monster, so it is the less cramped of the two.
